author: GamingBolt
description:
Well folks, Halo: Campaign Evolved has finally opened its doors to us and a few other early access enthusiasts. Has it been worth the wait, and lived up to the hype? Definitely yes. But does it do enough justice to the title’s first PlayStation appearance since the franchise’s origin, and its effort to modernise it for current-gen systems, to make it easy to recommend? That’s a tad trickier, but the news in our review is mostly good whether you're an absolute newbie or a returning veteran. 

Join us as we dive deep into this one, and look at how it manages to stand out from its predecessors while standing tall amongst the competition in a space that has become rather crowded since it hit the shelves all those years ago.
title: Halo: Campaign Evolved PS5 Review - A Must-Play for PS5 Players

author: GamingBolt
description:
Beast of Reincarnation is a title that Game Freak is going to be hoping for a win on, considering how it's a project that carries ambitions that go far beyond making a great game. 

It’s a foray into uncharted waters for Game Freak, and an opportunity for the studio known for making Pokemon games to carve out a new niche. Or the beginnings of one, at least. 

If this one is any good, it could do for Game Freak what Black Myth Wukong did for Game Science a couple of years ago. Wondering how we made that connection? It’s quite simple if you know where to look. Join us as we take you through how these two games share crucial similarities, and equally important differences.
title: Could Beast of Reincarnation Be the NEXT Black Myth: Wukong?

author: GamingBolt
description:
As jam-packed as July was for big releases, August is where the ball truly gets rolling. Right out of the gate, you have a highly anticipated action RPG and a big new fighting game from Arc System Works in the first week. The second week, you're looking at a massive new multiplayer shooter and DLC for Mafia: The Old Country. And it only escalates from there.

title: 15 NEW August 2026 Games You ABSOLUTELY NEED To Play
